mapper.sql: SELECT d.*,a.nickname display_name, CASE WHEN a.phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL THEN a.phone_cipher ELSE NULL END phone_cipher, a.status account_status, security.security_status,company.dept_name company_name, qualification.owner_dept_id qualification_owner_dept_id, qualification.company_revision qualification_company_revision FROM vi_driver_profile d JOIN vi_account a ON a.id=d.account_id LEFT JOIN vi_account_security security ON security.account_id=a.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept company ON company.dept_id=d.owner_dept_id LEFT JOIN vi_qualification_snapshot qualification ON qualification.id=d.effective_snapshot_id AND qualification.driver_id=d.id AND qualification.qualification_revision=d.qualification_revision
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_driver_profile d JOIN vi_account a ON a.id=d.account_id

SELECT ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vi_driver_occupancy WHERE driver_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vi_driver_assignment WHERE driver_id=#{id} AND ended_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vi_dispatch_invite WHERE driver_id=#{id} AND status='WAIT_RESPONSE') )
